<h2>Evaluate One sjSDM Fold Prediction Source</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Computes the registered binary metrics for one model or prevalence-null
probability vector, including typed incomplete rows.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>evaluate_sjsdm_prediction_source_metrics(
  vec_observed = NULL,
  vec_probability = NULL,
  prediction_source = NULL,
  flag_complete = NULL,
  incomplete_status = NULL,
  epsilon = 1e-06
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="vec_observed">vec_observed</code>, <code id="vec_probability">vec_probability</code></td>
<td>
<p>Binary observations and aligned probabilities.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="prediction_source">prediction_source</code></td>
<td>
<p>Source identifier stored in every metric row.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="flag_complete">flag_complete</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical indicating whether probabilities are complete.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="incomplete_status">incomplete_status</code></td>
<td>
<p>Status used for typed incomplete metric rows.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="epsilon">epsilon</code></td>
<td>
<p>Probability clipping tolerance for log loss and calibration.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Six-row source-metric tibble.
</p>

</main>
